data.summary: “Moms with Nutella 😏😏🤯. @MiniMoochi” has pulled 15,182,857 views at ~94,663/hour — well above a normal upload. It reads as a vlog whose strongest lever is relatability. The breakdown below frames the rest as likely contributors, not proven causes.

why_trending.detail: The framing targets a broad, relatable everyday situation, which likely widens the share-and-comment audience.
The first second of the title promises a clear, specific payoff, which likely earns the early swipe-through that short-form distribution rewards.
Views are accumulating far faster than a typical upload, and that early velocity likely compounds into broader recommendation.
